method: Each section read in full by a machine-assisted reviewer against the packs and the ground catalogue as of this date; not a legal review.

sections.bearsOn: Sets a visual quality objective for each scenic area polygon on the November 9, 2005 map; a block visible from a significant public viewpoint must keep the landscape's alteration within that category.
sections.gapNote: Rules now name the order and test the alteration entered from the visual quality page against the category; the planner does not read that page’s measurement itself.

sections.bearsOn: Ties the VQOs to the scenic areas established under GAR s. 7(1) by the December 6, 2005 order.
